title: QualifiedInterface
description: Provider-neutral interface identity — versioned, losslessly round-tripped. Interface identity is defined by interface_id, interface_version, schema_version, and status. Compatibility compares interface identity fields only — NOT provider or operation.

interface_version.description: Semantic version of the interface contract

schema_version.description: Version of the wire schema for this interface

status.description: Whether the interface is required or optional

schema_ref.description: Optional URI reference to the interface schema artifact

digest.description: Optional SHA-256 digest of the interface schema artifact

compatibility_metadata.description: Opaque compatibility metadata — Core does not interpret

owner_payload.description: Consumer-defined opaque payload — Core does not interpret
